title: DexPDF
description: A comprehensive PDF management tool for organizing, converting, and editing PDF documents seamlessly.
content:
## Overview
Check out **DexPDF**, the ultimate tool for handling PDF files locally in your browser. No data leaves your device, ensuring maximum privacy and security.

### Key Features
- **Client-Side Processing**: All operations happen in your browser.
- **Merge & Split**: Combine multiple PDFs or extract pages with ease.
- **Image to PDF**: Convert your images into professional documents.

title: DexKomik
description: Your ultimate portal for manga and comic reading, featuring a vast library and intuitive reader.
content:
## The Reading Experience
DexKomik provides a distraction-free environment for reading your favorite manga. 

### Technical Challenges
Building a robust scraping engine that respects rate limits while delivering fast content was the main challenge. We utilized **server-side caching** and optimized parsing logic to achieve sub-second load times.

title: DexAnime
